Hi all — tying up the items Ben promised. Attached are the artifacts and quick notes on each: 

1) Redwood_SOC2_Report_2025.pdf — SOC 2 Type II report (redacted), scope: infrastructure and platform controls covering hosted and dedicated deployments.
2) pen_test_summary_2025.pdf — high-level findings and remediation status; no PII in the report. Full tester contact available under NDA.
3) audit_logs_sample.csv — sample of API request logs (timestamps, request_id, model, route, region).
4) Redwood_SIG_Lite_answers.pdf — completed SIG-Lite (first pass).

Q&A (short answers):
- Data retention: default 90 days for request/response tokens in hosted by default; configurable for Dedicated/Private.
- Audit log granularity: per-request with timestamps, user_id (hashed), request_id and model routing.
- Encryption: at-rest AES-256; customer-managed keys supported via KMS/HSM in Private deployments.
- Access controls: RBAC + SSO (SAML/OIDC), audit trail in Console.

If Mark or your security team wants any additional detail or a live walkthrough of logs, happy to set up a session.

Thanks,
